name: Heavenly Vase
content:
**Item #:** COR-444

**Object Class:** Euclid

**Special Containment Procedures:** Must be kept in a large room, with titanium walls.

**Description:** An Athenian vase found in the rubble of ancient greece. Depicts 4 gods staring on each side of the vase, and is black and gold. Once 4 of any object is put into the vase, it will emit a golden light, before fusing those four objects into an object with the power of all 4 objects combined. However, if a liquid, no matter if alive or not, will immediately get shot out of the vase once put inside. The only way to bypass this is to keep the liquid into a completely full hollow glass sphere. This will cause it to fuse, however it may break depending on the strength of the glass.

**Addendum:** Do not put human life into this vase, or else it will turn to a sludge. Information is still being studied on this vase.

name: Relic Stealer
content: **Incident #:** INC-1134 **Date of Incident:** October 28, 2020 **Location:** COR-003 CONTAIMENT **Description:** On October 28, 2020, a man in a black robe with a white mask entered the relic containment chamber for COR-003. Upon entering COR-003's containment chamber, he took it, before speaking in an unintelligible language, which was caught by the facilities auto-transcriptors. **Aftermath & Disciplinary Action:** After the incident, we interviewed multiple people, but we got no leads, other than an image captured by the vent cameras.

name: The Glowing Mask
content:
**Item #:** COR-003

**Object Class:** Euclid

**Special Containment Procedures:** COR-003 must be contained in a titanium container at site 3, 5mm thick. It must be then surrounded by a 5 x 5 foot tub of water, and all testings must be done 10 feet away from the box.

**Description:** COR-003 is an ancient egyptian mask worn by the pharaoh. It has two exaggerated ears, and a long neck.

name: The Obsidian Compass
content:
**Item #:** COR-001

**Object Class:** Safe

**Special Containment Procedures:** COR-001 is to be kept in a standard secure containment locker at Site-19. Testing requires Level 3 authorization.

**Description:** COR-001 is a hand-carved compass composed of high-purity obsidian and brass. Instead of pointing toward magnetic north, the needle consistently rotates to indicate the nearest point of temporal anomaly or spatial distortion within a [REDACTED] kilometer radius.

name: Amnestic Phonograph
content:
**Item #:** COR-449

**Object Class:** Euclid

**Special Containment Procedures:** Stored in an acoustic dampening vault. No personnel are permitted within 5 meters while the cylinder is mounted.

**Description:** COR-449 is a 19th-century brass horn phonograph. When any wax cylinder is played on COR-449, listeners within hearing range immediately experience complete retrograde amnesia spanning the preceding [REDACTED] hours.
